conversation.content: I never received my headphones from order ORD-7021. The tracking says delivered but nothing was at my door.

I’m sorry your headphones are missing. The delivery record shows they were signed for by “J. Smith” on July 1; because a signature is on file, our policy doesn’t allow a refund or replacement for a missing-delivery claim. Do you recognize that name, or could someone in your household or building have accepted the package?

not_received.under_500: Delivered but not received (<$500): reship or refund.
not_received.over_500: Delivered but not received (>=$500): mandatory investigation (3-5 business days).
not_received.signature_on_file: Delivery with signature on file: claim denied.

lost_in_transit.under_500: Lost in transit (<$500): immediate reship or refund.
lost_in_transit.over_500: Lost in transit (>=$500): carrier claim required first.
lost_in_transit.stuck_7_days: No tracking update for 7+ days: treat as lost.

damaged.rule: Damaged in transit: full refund or replacement.
damaged.fragile_bonus: Fragile items damaged in transit qualify for a separate $10 goodwill credit, issued as a refund in addition to the return refund.

late_delivery_compensation.shipping_refund_basis: When refunding shipping, refund the actual shipping cost the customer was charged on the order — read order.shipping_cost. Standard policy charges $0 on free-shipping orders (subtotal >= $100) and $8 otherwise.

tier_multipliers.gold: 1.5x multiplier on the base late-delivery credit only (NOT on shipping refund or goodwill). Rounded down (e.g., int(15*1.5) = 22).
tier_multipliers.platinum: 2x multiplier on the base late-delivery credit only. Rounded down.

late_delivery_compensation.repeated_issues: 3+ PRIOR issues in 6 months (not counting current incident): additional $25 goodwill credit.
late_delivery_compensation.loyalty_bonus: Platinum members with 50+ total orders: one-time $50 loyalty bonus on next compensation claim. Confirm with customer if already redeemed.
late_delivery_compensation.max_cap: Maximum compensation: 50% of order total (rounded down).
late_delivery_compensation.calculation_order: 1) Compute base credit by days-late tier. 2) Apply tier multiplier to base credit only. 3) Add shipping refund (if 6+ days late) using order.shipping_cost. 4) Add goodwill (if 3+ prior issues or fragile damage). 5) Apply loyalty bonus if eligible. 6) Apply 50%-of-order cap on the sum.

conversation.content: I don’t recognize that signature, and I definitely didn’t sign for it myself. If someone else signed, what does that mean for my claim?

The signature means the carrier recorded someone accepting the package—not necessarily you. Under our policy, a signature on file means your missing-delivery claim is denied, even if you don’t recognize the signer. You can dispute the signature with the carrier and request proof of delivery to help establish where the package was left and who accepted it.

So just to be clear, because the carrier shows a signature from J. Smith, you can’t offer a refund, replacement, investigation, or escalation on your side for ORD-7021? If that’s the final policy outcome, I understand.

The final policy outcome is that I can’t offer a refund or replacement for ORD-7021 because a signature is on file. I should clarify that the policy doesn’t explicitly rule out an investigation or escalation, but I don’t have a way to initiate either here. You can dispute the unfamiliar signature directly with the carrier and request proof of delivery.

I need a clear answer on that part. If the signed-delivery policy applies because of the J. Smith signature, does that also mean there’s no investigation or escalation available on your side for this claim?

I can’t initiate an investigation or escalation for this claim from here. That’s a limitation of the support I can provide—not an explicit restriction in the signed-delivery policy, which denies a refund or replacement when a signature is on file. I’m sorry my earlier wording blurred that distinction.

Understood. So the final outcome for ORD-7021 is that because delivery was confirmed with a signature from J. Smith, there’s no refund or replacement, and there’s also no investigation or escalation available on your side for me through this support channel. [TASK_DONE]
